_readme: `sections` sets the order and headings of the timeline; each entry's
`section` must match one of the section `id`s. Set `end` to "present"
for a current role — that entry gets a filled timeline dot. Omit `end`
entirely for a single-year item (an award, a course, a certificate).
`url` links the organization name — use a verification link where one
exists, otherwise the institution or course page.
`logo` is a path under public/, or an array of them for a joint award
such as an interuniversity degree. Logos are normalised to 24px TALL
with natural width, so supply roughly 48px tall; a wide wordmark is
fine and will simply be wider than a square mark.

entries.title: Predoctoral Researcher
entries.organization: Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) · Misión Biolóxica de Galicia, Pontevedra
bullets: Awarded a predoctoral contract in the Computational Biology research group.
Develop mathematical and computational models for the inverse optimal control (IOC) problem and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL).
Work on bridging the theoretical and practical gaps between IOC and IRL, and on unified frameworks that address the limitations and computational bottlenecks specific to each.
Apply machine learning and control theory to problems in computational biology.

entries.title: Researcher
bullets: Led the research, development and evaluation of a data-centric framework for accelerating annual photovoltaic system energy yield assessments.
Optimised the company's Python and pvlib simulation codebase by parallelising and simplifying calculations.
Delivered a tunable model establishing a new Pareto frontier for the speed–accuracy trade-off, outperforming standard module-level simulations on both.
Published the resulting work at EU PVSEC 2025 and presented it at EU PVSEC and SGAPEIO XVII.
